repair_reason: The first held-out audit found that predeclared malicious-provenance and synthesis-infeasibility states were not represented in controller-visible contract verification.
repair_scope: expose only simulated pre-action provenance-attestation validity, never an oracle queue or outcome
expose the pre-action contract-synthesis feasibility result
map invalid provenance and infeasible synthesis to the existing admission contract clauses
training_policy: Refit the unchanged estimator on the already-permitted, estimable final-005 training rows. This amendment followed a fresh-training overlap failure that occurred before repair decision persistence and before any repair held-out outcome access.

reuse_policy.ns3: reuse checksum-validated final-005 evidence because the controller contract repair does not change the ns-3 network model
reuse_policy.m12: reuse checksum-validated final-005 captures because the repair does not change packet capture
reuse_policy.first_heldout_run: retain as a negative validity-audit artifact; never overwrite or present as confirmatory repair evidence

exclusions: zero outcome-based exclusions; preserve every failure and negative result
